title: 第十四章 无需慌张第十五章 新技能
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 以狐狸之躯生火确实是件颇为不便的事。
木柴之类的东西只能靠嘴叼来。
幸好，季南北之前刷魔道点数时，得到了一枚三品的“火元珠”，生火倒是不用发愁。
一边费力地将兔子架到树枝上，季南北一边随口问道:
“对了，你有名字吗?“
“有!我叫苏千雪，是母亲给我取的!”
然而，话音刚落，季南北立刻感觉到从小狐狸身上传来的那股深切的悲伤。
苏千雪啊......季南北没有多问，只是默默地将火上已经烤得差不多的兔子取下，撕下一块送入口中。
感受到进食带来的满足感，小狐狸原本悲伤的情绪也渐渐平复了许多。
“仙人你有名字吗?你叫什么呀?”
“你以后称呼我‘前辈’就好。”
“哇，好的前辈!“
吃完一整只兔子后，季南北感觉差不多有七分饱了。
毕竟苏千雪体型还小，还算比较好养活。
随后，季南北观察了一下周围的地形。
很快，季南北判断出，这片密林和他家后山的情况差不多，肯定也位于深山老林之中。这意味着人迹罕至，以及......
深处必然存在着较强的妖兽。
得先找个安全的地方。
即使只是为了苏千雪身上的天赋，季南北也得保住这只小狐狸的性命。
毕竟，只有仍处于夺舍槽位上的目标无论是人是妖，其对应的天赋才能用魔道点数进行兑换。
而如果主动删除，或者目标死亡，就会从夺舍槽位上消失，届时，相应的可兑换天赋也会一并失去。
但如何确保这只小狐狸的安全，却是个问题。密林之中潜藏着危险的妖兽。
然而离开这片密林又不现实。
首先，季南北完全不清楚方位。
他现在就像是被随机丢进了一处深山，不见天日，连东南西北都难以分辨。
况且，即使能走出这片密林......
难道要去外面有人的地方吗?
看着自己毛茸茸的雪白爪子，季南北摇了摇头。
这小家伙一看就是相当稀罕的妖类，在修真界恐怕待不了两天，不是被人抓去当灵宠，就是变成哪位女修颈间的白绒披肩了。
只能在密林中寻觅一处安稳的栖身之所。
稍加思索后，季南北想到了一个办法。
他在林间奔跑起来，仔细查探着周围的痕迹。
很快，季南北便感觉到一股相当强大的气息。这附近几乎看不到什么动物。
显然，前方这地方肯定盘踞着某种强大的妖兽，其散发的气息足以让寻常动物不敢靠近。
系统面板适时弹出。
【触发强敌讨伐，请从以下三项中选择一项完成。】
选项一:左转后，直行四千步，攀上高山，完成讨伐。（奖赏:二十万魔道点数，五品灵宝“蕴灵珠”。）
选项二:继续向前，进入山洞，完成本次讨伐。（奖赏:五万魔道点数，三品灵物“合欢散”。）
选项三:右转后，直行两千步，爬上高树，完成本次讨伐。（奖赏:一千魔道点数，随机一品丹药一瓶。）
季南北看着面板，有些无奈。
看来这次得选第二项了。第三项的奖励实在太少，这说明讨伐目标的实力相对较弱。
这种目标，无法达成季南北的目的。
季南北打算找一只较强的妖兽击杀，然后鸠占鹊巢。
这样一来，至少一段时间内，这只妖兽残留的威势未散，小狐狸苏千雪就能相对安全。

;;
It is indeed quite inconvenient to make a fire with the body of a fox.
Things like firewood can only be brought in by mouth.
Fortunately, Ji Nanbei got a third-grade "Fire Yuan Pearl" when he spent magic points before, so he didn't have to worry about making a fire.
While struggling to put the rabbit on the branch, Ji Nanbei asked casually:
"By the way, do you have a name?"
"Yes! My name is Su Qianxue, my mother named it to me!"
However, as soon as he finished speaking, Ji Nanbei immediately felt the deep sadness coming from the little fox.
Su Qianxue... Ji Nanbei didn't ask any questions. He just silently took off the rabbit that was almost roasted on the fire, tore off a piece and put it in his mouth.
Feeling the satisfaction brought by eating, the little fox's original sad mood gradually calmed down a lot.
"Do you have a name, Immortal? What is your name?"
"You can just call me 'Senior' from now on."
"Wow, good senior!"
After eating a whole rabbit, Ji Nanbei felt almost seventy percent full.
After all, Su Qianxue is still small and relatively easy to feed.
Afterwards, Ji Nanbei observed the surrounding terrain.
Soon, Ji Nanbei judged that this dense forest was similar to the situation in the mountains behind his home, and it must be located in the deep mountains and old forests. This means off the beaten path, and…
There must be stronger monsters in the depths.
You have to find a safe place first.
Even if it was just for Su Qianxue's talent, Ji Nanbei had to save the little fox's life.
After all, only if the target is still in the body seizing slot, whether it is a human or a demon, its corresponding talent can be redeemed with magic points.
If it is deleted voluntarily or the target dies, it will disappear from the body seizing slot. At that time, the corresponding redeemable talents will also be lost.
But how to ensure the safety of this little fox is a problem. Dangerous monsters lurk in the dense forest.
However, leaving this dense forest is unrealistic.
First of all, Ji Nanbei didn't know the direction at all.
It was as if he had been randomly thrown into a deep mountain, without seeing the light of day, and it was difficult to tell the difference between east, west, and north.
Besides, even if we can get out of this dense forest...
Do you want to go somewhere where there are people outside?
Looking at his furry, snow-white paws, Ji Nanbei shook his head.
This little guy looks like a very rare monster at first glance. I'm afraid he won't be able to stay in the world of cultivation for more than two days. Either he will be captured and used as a spiritual pet, or he will become a white velvet shawl around the neck of some female cultivator.
They can only find a stable shelter in the dense forest.
After thinking for a while, Ji Nanbei thought of a way.
He ran through the forest, carefully examining the surrounding areas.
Soon, Ji Nanbei felt a very powerful aura. There are almost no animals around here.
Obviously, there must be some kind of powerful monster occupying the place ahead, and its aura is enough to make ordinary animals afraid to approach.
The system panel pops up in due course.
[To trigger a powerful enemy crusade, please choose one of the following three items to complete. 】
Option 1: After turning left, go straight four thousand steps, climb the mountain, and complete the crusade. (Reward: 200,000 magic points, fifth-grade spiritual treasure "Yunling Pearl".)
Option 2: Continue forward, enter the cave, and complete this crusade. (Reward: 50,000 magic points, third-grade spiritual object "Hehuan Powder".)
Option 3: After turning right, go straight for two thousand steps, climb the tall tree, and complete this crusade. (Reward: one thousand magic points, a bottle of random first-grade elixir.)
Ji Nanbei looked at the panel, feeling helpless.
It seems that I have to choose the second option this time. The reward for the third item is too small, which shows that the target of the crusade is relatively weak.
This kind of goal cannot achieve Ji Nanbei's goal.
Ji Nanbei planned to find a stronger monster to kill, and then occupy the magpie's nest.
In this way, at least for a period of time, the remaining power of this monster beast will not dissipate, and the little fox Su Qianxue will be relatively safe.
